name: search for a difference of squares near the square root
mechanism: starting at the ceiling of the square root, test successive values a for whether a squared minus the target is a perfect square; when it is, the target factors as the product of the sum and difference

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fermat's factorization method' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms:

fails_when: slow unless the two factors are close
